claims.text: The Assembly reports that on 29 December 2014 Interim Speaker Lord Tupou announced two nominations in Parliament: caretaker Deputy Prime Minister Samiu Kuita Vaipulu, nominated by Vili Hingano on December 22, and Samuela 'Akilisi Pohiva, nominated by Dr. Pohiva Tu'i'onetoa.
claims.uncertainty: Procedural. Tu'i'onetoa's nomination was lodged on 23 December (Assembly item 290, not imported separately).
